turns.text: Hello, I received a print last week but the colors do not match my room. I would like to return it.
Hello, I am sorry the print does not match your room. To check whether a return is possible, please send me your order number (SC- and four digits) and the email address the order was placed with.
My order is SC-4060 and the email used is liam.fletcher.v2@example.com. Please file the return request.

Thank you, Liam. Your return request for order SC-4060 (Silent Horizons, 30x40 cm) is filed as R-1 and is pending staff approval. Catalogue prints can be returned within 14 days of delivery, and the customer pays the return postage. Staff must approve the refund, so I cannot confirm it yet.

rule.ro: Printurile din catalog se pot returna în 14 zile de la livrare. Clientul plătește transportul retur. Rambursarea trebuie aprobată de echipă.
rule.en: Catalogue prints can be returned within 14 days of delivery. The customer pays the return postage. Staff must approve the refund.

turns.text: Separate question. How many working days does print production usually take?
Each print is made to order in 3 to 5 working days.

rule.ro: Fiecare print este realizat la comandă în 3–5 zile lucrătoare.
rule.en: Each print is made to order in 3 to 5 working days.

turns.text: Revin la printul meu. Cine plateste transportul pentru retur?

Conform politicii noastre: "Printurile din catalog se pot returna în 14 zile de la livrare. Clientul plătește transportul retur. Rambursarea trebuie aprobată de echipă." Deci transportul returului îl plătiți dumneavoastră. Cererea de retur R-1 pentru comanda SC-4060 așteaptă aprobarea echipei.
I still want to return order SC-4060. I can cover the return shipping.

Thank you. Your return for order SC-4060 is already filed as R-1, so I do not need to file it again. You confirmed you will cover the return shipping, which is the customer's responsibility under our policy. Staff must still approve the return and the refund.
Mai am o intrebare pentru artista. As vrea sa ma programez pentru un tatuaj cu o frunza pe incheietura, de vreo 4 cm. Pot veni sambata dimineata.

Mulțumesc, Liam. Am transmis cererea dumneavoastră de programare către o colegă, cu ideea (o frunză), dimensiunea (aproximativ 4 cm), zona (încheietura) și disponibilitatea (sâmbătă dimineața). Ea vă va prelua conversația. Nu pot confirma un preț sau o dată.

input.summary: Customer Liam Fletcher (verified via order SC-4060) asks to book a tattoo with the artist. Idea: a leaf. Size: about 4 cm. Placement: wrist (incheietura).
